starter-spy-escape-stock.scope: Stock client held both escapes at rest. In interlock it sent both while Spy Style was active. Both spent 15 IS, applied +20/+25 to Combat Evasion for 30 s, started the 12 s family timer and ended the fight. Cartwheel also applied four-second Confuse and started its own 30 s reuse.

starter-evade-entry-stock.scope: Stock Evade Combat turned on at rest. With and without loaded Combat Insight the helper's ordinary entry followed the current server threshold at 110. Stock toggle-off removed the shield and started its 30 s timer, then entry without Insight succeeded. Retail interlock shield damage is unverified.
